summary: Correctly replaces buggy string comparison with semantic version comparison via packaging.version.parse, properly resolving the reported version-ordering bug (0.10 > 0.6). Fix is minimal and behaviorally correct; only a minor style nit on import placement.

issues.description: Import `from packaging.version import parse as parse_version` placed inside the function (within the loop body) rather than at module top, against PEP8/repo convention. Import caching makes the perf cost negligible, but it should be hoisted to module level for readability.

parse_version on a malformed/non-PEP440 version string can raise InvalidVersion, a slightly different failure mode than the old string compare. 'unknown version' is short-circuited so the common case is safe; real extension versions are virtually always PEP440-compliant, so regression risk is low.
